# E0340: a lens reads a field its source version does not declare

A mapping reads a field its source version does not declare. No instance of the
source has it, so the lens never has a value to copy.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	b: string
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		b: v0_0.nope
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	b: string
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0340]: 0.0 does not declare nope
 --> ship/history/1.0.thema:8:6
  |
8 |         b: v0_0.nope
  |            ^^^^
  |

error[E0347]: 0.0 declares a and 1.0 does not, and nothing maps it: write <field>: v0_0.a to move it, or a: _drop
 --> ship/history/1.0.thema:5:1
  |
5 | ForwardLens: {
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^
  |
```
